narrative.overview: MSystem is the screen behind the register, not a product a customer ever opens. Every choice serves the cashier mid-transaction, with a line at the counter and store lighting washing out anything low-contrast. It runs on Bootstrap 3's Flatly theme with a handful of local overrides, and this is explicitly a transitional state on the way to Bootstrap 5.
keyCharacteristics: Flat everywhere: no shadows, no gradients, 4px or 0px corners only.
Two-tier header: 0.2em-padding topbar (session/clock) stacked on the Flatly navbar (module nav).
Module nav items are icon-over-label, not icon-beside-label.
High-contrast state colors reserved for buttons and badges, never large surfaces.

rules.name: The No-New-Chrome-Color Rule
rules.body: This palette is inherited, not designed. Don't introduce a new hex value for a new UI element; reuse an existing one, or defer to the Bootstrap 5 migration.

rules.name: The Legibility-Over-Density Rule
rules.body: Never shrink body text below 13px to fit more into a table. Add horizontal scroll or drop a column first.

rules.name: The Flat-Chrome Rule
rules.body: The topbar and navbar are solid color fills, never gradients or shadowed panels.

dos: Do keep the navbar and topbar flat solid fills. No gradients, no shadows on these bars.
Do keep the active-module white pill rather than reverting to Flatly's default darker-navy active state.
Do treat any navbar/topbar change as provisional given the pending Bootstrap 5 migration.
Do keep body text at 13px minimum and page titles at 22px.
Do preserve the existing mobile nav rewrite instead of falling back to the desktop icon-grid at small widths.
donts: Don't make this look like a legacy spreadsheet: no dense unstyled tables, no tiny unlabeled icon-only controls, no gray-on-gray low-contrast text.
Don't make this look like a generic SaaS dashboard: no card-grid homepage, no hero-metric tiles, no gradient accents.
Don't introduce a new accent color for a single feature.
Don't add shadows, blur, or glassmorphism to the topbar/navbar.
Don't use border-left/border-right colored stripes anywhere in this system.
